definition_zh: 上诉的；受理上诉的；与上诉审有关的
definition_en: relating to or having the power to hear appeals and review the decisions of lower courts
core_image: 更高的法庭：低位法官判完，卷宗被送往高处的法庭复核
scene: 初审失利后，律师把厚厚的卷宗递交给更高一级的法庭。The appellate court agreed to review the lower court's decision.
sceneCN: 这里 appellate 是「上诉的、受理上诉的」（第 1 个义项：与上诉审有关的）；句意为：上诉法院同意复核下级法院的判决。

pos.zh: 上诉的；受理上诉的；用于上诉审的

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁词根 appellare（呼喊）直接发展而来，义为「上诉；呼吁」
同根派生，义为「名称；称号」
复合术语，义为「上诉管辖权」

senses.title: Relating to appeals in law
senses.definition: connected with the process of asking a higher court to change a decision
senses.definitionCN: 与请求上级法院改变原判的程序有关的
senses.example: She filed an appellate motion last week.
senses.exampleCN: 她上周提交了上诉动议。
senses.why: The word is built on appeal, so its basic image is carrying a case upward to a higher court.
senses.whyCN: 这个词建立在 appeal（上诉）之上，基本意象就是把案子向上递送到更高的法庭。

senses.title: Having the power to hear appeals
senses.definition: describing a court that is authorized to review decisions made by lower courts
senses.definitionCN: 形容有权复核下级法院裁决的法院
senses.example: The appellate court overturned the verdict.
senses.why: Once a case moves upward, the court that receives it gains the special name appellate court.
senses.whyCN: 案子被向上递送后，接手的法院就获得了「上诉法院」这一专门名称。

senses.title: Concerned with judges of appeal courts
senses.definition: describing judges whose work is to review earlier rulings rather than hold trials
senses.definitionCN: 形容职责是复核先前裁决而非开庭初审的法官
senses.example: An appellate judge questioned both lawyers for hours.
senses.exampleCN: 一位上诉法官盘问了双方律师数小时。
senses.why: The reviewing work defines the person, so the adjective extends naturally from court to judge.
senses.whyCN: 复核工作定义了这类法官，于是形容词自然从法院延伸到法官身上。

senses.title: Concerned with review of legal error
senses.definition: involving the examination of whether the lower court applied the law correctly
senses.definitionCN: 指审查下级法院适用法律是否正确的审级活动
senses.example: The appellate focus was on legal error, not new evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 上诉审查的重点是法律错误，而非新证据。
senses.why: Reviewing means checking the reasoning, which narrows the image to questions of law.
senses.whyCN: 复核意味着检查推理过程，意象因此聚焦在法律适用问题上。

senses.title: Of appellate jurisdiction
senses.definition: describing the official authority of a higher court to take appeals
senses.definitionCN: 形容上级法院受理上诉案件的法定权力
senses.example: The Supreme Court exercised its appellate jurisdiction.
senses.exampleCN: 最高法院行使了上诉管辖权。
senses.why: Power follows the process: the court that can hear appeals holds appellate jurisdiction.
senses.whyCN: 权力随程序而来：能受理上诉的法院就拥有上诉管辖权。

senses.title: Following the appeal track
senses.definition: describing procedures, briefs, or stages that belong to the appeal process
senses.definitionCN: 形容属于上诉流程的程序、文书或阶段
senses.example: They missed the appellate deadline by two days.
senses.exampleCN: 他们错过上诉期限两天。
senses.why: The whole machinery of the appeal route borrows the same adjective as the court itself.
senses.whyCN: 上诉路线上的整套机器都沿用法院本身的这个形容词。

senses.title: Concerned with appellate argument
senses.definition: describing oral arguments presented before a reviewing court
senses.definitionCN: 形容在复核法庭前进行的言词辩论
senses.example: Her appellate argument lasted only twenty minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 她的上诉辩论只持续了二十分钟。
senses.why: Argument is the spoken part of review, so it takes the same label.
senses.whyCN: 辩论是复核程序的口头部分，因此沿用同一标签。

senses.title: Contrasted with trial-level matters
senses.definition: used to distinguish reviewing functions from first-instance trial functions
senses.definitionCN: 用于把复核职能与初审职能区分开
senses.example: Trial courts find facts; appellate courts correct mistakes.
senses.exampleCN: 初审法院认定事实，上诉法院纠正错误。
senses.why: The word exists mainly to mark the boundary between two levels of judging.
senses.whyCN: 这个词存在的意义主要就是标出两级审判之间的界线。

intro.en: Appellate comes straight from the Latin verb appellare, to address or call upon, through the legal sense of calling a higher court.
intro.cn: appellate 直接来自拉丁语动词 appellare（称呼、呼唤），经「呼唤更高法院」的法律义发展而来。

items.en: The reconstructed root *pel- meant to thrust or drive, giving Latin pellere, to push or beat.
items.cn: 重构词根 *pel- 意为「推动、驱赶」，衍生出拉丁语 pellere（推、击打）。

items.en: Appellare, formed with the intensive prefix ad- plus pellere, meant to drive toward, hence to address or call upon by name.
items.cn: appellare 由加强前缀 ad- 加 pellere 构成，意为「向……驱使」，引申为「称呼、呼唤」。

items.en: In Roman law, appellare meant to call upon a higher magistrate against a decision, the ancestor of the legal appeal.
items.cn: 在罗马法中，appellare 指就某一裁决呼唤更高的长官，是法律上诉的祖先。

items.en: appeler carried both the naming sense and the legal sense into medieval French.
items.cn: appeler 把「命名」与「上诉」两义一并带入中古法语。

items.en: English adopted appeal and then the Late Latin adjective form appellate for courts of appeal.
items.cn: 英语先吸收 appeal，再借后期拉丁语形容词形式 appellate 称呼上诉法院。

items.en: Today appellate is almost entirely a legal term for the reviewing level of the judiciary.
items.cn: 如今 appellate 几乎完全是司法术语，指复核审级。

note.en: Appellate is easily confused with words built on the same Latin root and with near legal terms.
note.cn: appellate 容易与同根词以及近义法律术语混淆。

entries.definition: to request that a higher court review a decision; a formal request
entries.definitionCN: 请求上级法院复核裁决；正式的请求

entries.definition: a name or title given to someone or something
the authority of a court to review lower court decisions
entries.definitionCN: 法院复核下级裁决的权力

entries.definition: examining something again, as an appellate body examines a case
entries.definitionCN: 再次审查的，如复核机构审查案件

entries.definition: belonging to a court above the trial level
entries.definitionCN: 属于高于初审法院的审级的

entries.definition: having power to revise or correct earlier decisions
entries.definitionCN: 有修订或纠正先前裁决权力的

normalIntro.en: Remember appellate through its family of call-words from Latin appellare.
normalIntro.cn: 通过拉丁语 appellare 的「呼唤」词族来记 appellate。

normal.cn: appellate = appeal + -ate，字面就是「与上诉有关的」。

normal.en: Latin ad- (toward) + pellere (drive): calling a court 'toward' you.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ pellere（驱使）：把法院「唤向」自己。

normal.en: Appellation means a name; appellate means the court you call upon.
normal.cn: appellation 是「名称」，appellate 是「你呼唤的法院」，两词同根。

normal.en: Collocation anchor: appellate court is the standard phrase.
normal.cn: 搭配锚点：appellate court 是标准说法。

normal.en: Trial courts find facts; appellate courts correct them.
normal.cn: 初审法院认定事实，上诉法院纠正错误——记住这组分工。

abstract.en: Picture an escalator carrying a case file up to a taller courthouse.
abstract.cn: 想象一部扶梯把案卷送上更高的法院大楼。

abstract.en: The higher court's door has a bell: you ring it to appeal.
abstract.cn: 高处法院的门上挂着一口钟：敲钟即是呼唤复核。

abstract.en: Appellate sounds like 'a peal' — a peal of bells calling the case upward.
abstract.cn: appellate 听着像 a peal——一阵钟声把案子召唤上去。

examples.en: The appellate court reversed the lower court's ruling.
examples.cn: 上诉法院推翻了下级法院的裁决。

examples.en: He has argued dozens of cases in appellate courts.
examples.cn: 他在上诉法院辩护过几十起案件。

examples.en: Appeals must follow strict appellate procedures.
examples.cn: 上诉必须遵循严格的上诉程序。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿牌勒特」——上诉就像拿着「阿爸的牌」勒令下级法院重新审，别把谐音当词源。

root: 拉丁词根 pell-/pel-（推、驱使）：appellate 由 ad-（朝向）+ pellere（驱使）构成，本义「向……呼唤」，引申为「呼唤上级法院复核」，即上诉的。

sensesIntro.en: From the core image of calling a case upward, appellate spreads to courts, judges, jurisdiction, procedure, argument, and the trial-versus-review contrast.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「把案子向上呼唤」的核心意象出发，appellate 依次铺开到法院、法官、管辖权、程序、辩论以及初审与复核的对照。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a case being called upward to a higher court
core.cn: 核心意象：案件被呼唤着向上送往更高的法庭

branches.en: the upward journey of a case: appeal and its procedure
branches.cn: 案件的向上旅程：上诉及其程序

branches.en: the receiving side: courts and judges empowered to hear appeals
branches.cn: 接手的一方：有权受理上诉的法院与法官

branches.en: what may be reviewed: legal error under appellate jurisdiction
branches.cn: 可复核的内容：上诉管辖权下的法律错误

branches.en: the spoken moment: appellate argument before the panel
branches.cn: 口头时刻：合议庭前的上诉辩论

branches.en: the dividing line: trial facts versus appellate correction
branches.cn: 分界线：初审事实与上诉纠错

intro.en: Appellate is built from Latin parts, and the same parts build a whole family of English words.
intro.cn: appellate 由拉丁语部件构成，同样的部件还构成了英语里一整族词。

latinIntro.en: The core is Latin pellere, to drive or push, one of the most productive Latin roots.
latinIntro.cn: 核心是拉丁语 pellere（驱使、推动），属最高产的拉丁词根之一。

latinEntries.exampleCN: 称呼元老的名号是罗马习俗。

derivatives.zh: 同根派生，义为「名称；称号」
